text:
ana: Heads-up: planning our public release + product webinar next week. Need eng + docs to finalize changelog, anchors for blog CTAs, and confirm a short canary window. Can we aim to have PRs merged within 36h?
kevin: Share the changelog PR link and exact anchor slugs you want; I'll review and schedule canary if infra's free.
nana: Draft changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321 — changelog at docs/changes/release-2026-03-31.md. Marketing wants anchors for 'model-fallback' and 'dedicated-trial' plus a short example snippet for the form. Canary preferred: Tue 09:00-10:30 PST.
ravi: We'll include a small copy block in the blog that references the dedicated trial CTA. Marketing needs the final docs URL to populate the signup flow.
sel: I can add anchors. Propose anchor text: "Model fallback & routing" -> #model-fallback, and "Try Dedicated" -> #dedicated-trial. I'll push a docs patch in ~2h and link to a sample CTA code block.
kevin: Sounds good. Also want the post to mention fallback behavior to the smaller model variant under load. Ops: @deploy-bot reserve canary slot and tag the release candidate.
deploy-bot: Canary booking confirmed: 2026-03-31T09:00:00-07:00 to 2026-03-31T10:30:00-07:00. Tag created: rc/2026-03-31-web.
noah: For inbound routing: will growth use a separate nurture stream for Dedicated leads? If yes, we need the doc anchor that has trial instructions + contact info.
sel: I'll include a dedicated-trial section at /docs/dedicated/trial-setup and add an email snippet and sample webhook payload for nurture forms.
kevin: I'll do a quick integration test post-merge to ensure anchors resolve. If anything breaks we'll delay public announcement by 2 hours and push a reduced-post (webinar only) instead.
ravi: Webinar speakers: Kevin confirmed for demo + Q&A (15m), product for roadmap (10m). Marketing to provide deck by Mon EOD.
nana: Timeline proposal: docs + changelog merged by Mon 20:00 UTC, canary Tue 09:00-10:30 PST, public post Tue 11:00 PST, webinar Thu 16:00 UTC. Everyone OK?
kevin: OK for eng. I'll try to land changelog earlier this afternoon.
sel: Done — docs PR created and includes anchors and CTA snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987.
nana: Perfect. I'll draft the blog with those anchor links and drop the deck for review by Mon 14:00 UTC.
kevin: Quick ops note for merging:
```
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git fetch upstream
git cherry-pick 5f7e2ab # changelog commit
git push origin main
```
noah: Growth will wire the form to /docs/dedicated/trial-setup and tag leads with "dedicated-interest". Will run a dry test after docs merge.
nana: Thanks team — if the canary shows any latency spike we revert and reschedule announce. Otherwise we go live and send partner pre-announce 30m before public post. :rocket:
